entry.title: New: Bill 96 (2023) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2024 BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF MAUI, OFFICE OF THE MAYOR, ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM, WAILUKU AND WEST MAUI ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT, ENVIRONMENTAL, AND CULTURAL PROGRAMS" This bill proposes to amend the FY 2024 Budget to update the fiscal sponsor for Retree Hawaiʻi under both the Wailuku and West Maui Economic Development, Environmental, and Cultural Programs line items from "Lōkahi Pacific" to "Nā Koa Manu Conservation".
